description: Paid ($0.01 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): call this before you sign. Send the transaction, token approval, EIP-712 signature (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 x402 payment, Seaport) or EIP-7702 authorization (type authorization: delegating the wallet to a contract, the sweeper trap) your agent is about to sign; get back green, orange or red with reason codes: who gets access, whether the spender or recipient is flagged, sanctioned (OFAC SDN) or unverified, unlimited allowances, and the token itself (honeypot, fake look-alike, high tax). On Solana (type solana, the base64 wire transaction): every instruction decoded and the transaction simulated (token account takeovers, System Assign, unlimited delegates, durable nonces, hidden owner or delegate changes). On the XRP Ledger (type xrpl, the unsigned tx JSON): account takeovers (SetRegularKey, SignerListSet, disabling the master key), fake RLUSD, partial payments, missing destination tags, trust-line and issuer risks, and DEX offers far below market. On Algorand (type algorand, base64 msgpack transaction or group in transactions): rekeys, closing the account or an asset to someone else, clawbacks, fake USDC, app update/delete/clear, simulated. Only proceed on green; on orange ask your user; never sign on red. Same as POST /v1/check. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

address.description: authorization: the contract the EIP-7702 authorization delegates the wallet to (0x0…0 clears a delegation). Any delegation hands the contract the whole wallet: orange EIP7702_AUTHORIZATION unless the contract is on GoPlus's trust list; red AUTHORIZATION_TO_NO_CONTRACT, AUTHORIZATION_TO_UNVERIFIED_CONTRACT, AUTHORIZATION_TO_FLAGGED_CONTRACT, SANCTIONED_ADDRESS

amount.description: approval: amount in base units (0 = revoke)

authorizationChainId.description: authorization, optional: the chain id inside the authorization, chainId (default) or 0 = valid on every chain (orange AUTHORIZATION_ALL_CHAINS)

chainId.description: EVM chain id, required for approval, transaction, signature and authorization: 1, 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161 (8453 = Base); optional for message

from.description: transaction, message or authorization, optional: your wallet address (authorization: its current delegation is shown); the transaction is then simulated (what really leaves and arrives; orange HIDDEN_APPROVAL, SIMULATION_NFT_OUT, SIMULATION_FAILS) and its recipients are compared with who this wallet paid before (red ADDRESS_POISONING for a look-alike)

intent.description: optional: what you are trying to do, in one sentence (e.g. "swap 10 USDC for ETH on Uniswap"); orange INTENT_MISMATCH when signing would do more or something else

message.description: message: the text or 0x-hex about to be signed; a Sign-In with Ethereum message for another site than origin is red, unreadable bytes are orange

method.description: message: how it is signed (default personal_sign); eth_sign is always red

origin.description: optional: the site asking for the signature or transaction (URL or hostname); a domain under 30 days old is orange

transaction.description: solana: the base64 wire transaction about to be signed; decoded and simulated (red SOLANA_TOKEN_ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER, SOLANA_ACCOUNT_ASSIGN; orange SOLANA_UNLIMITED_DELEGATE, SOLANA_DURABLE_NONCE, HIDDEN_APPROVAL, SIMULATION_FAILS). algorand: one base64 msgpack transaction (unsigned or signed); red ALGORAND_REKEY, ALGORAND_CLOSE_ACCOUNT, ALGORAND_ASSET_CLOSE, ALGORAND_FAKE_STABLECOIN; simulated

transactions.description: algorand: an atomic group, each a base64 msgpack transaction; send the whole group so every transaction is checked

tx.description: xrpl: the unsigned transaction JSON (TransactionType, Account, Destination, Amount, …), including CredentialCreate and CredentialAccept

type.description: What the agent is about to sign; authorization = an EIP-7702 authorization delegating the wallet to the contract in address; message = a plain personal_sign / eth_sign message in message; solana = a Solana transaction in transaction; xrpl = an unsigned XRP Ledger transaction in tx; algorand = an Algorand transaction in transaction, or a group in transactions

typedData.description: signature: the exact eth_signTypedData_v4 payload (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 x402 payment, Seaport)

x402.description: optional, EIP-3009 payments only: the x402 payment requirements you are paying ({ accepted: { scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra } }, one entry of the 402's accepts); red when the signature pays more, someone else, another token or chain

name: presign_check

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

anyOf.description: Why the verdict is what it is

code.description: Reason code, e.g. SPENDER_FLAGGED, UNLIMITED_ALLOWANCE, TOKEN_HONEYPOT

subject.description: The address or item the reason is about (null or absent when it is about the whole request)

reasons.description: Why the verdict is what it is

anyOf.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the verdict to your arguments

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the verdict to your arguments

anyOf.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy

verdict.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy (absent on the payment requirement)
